tasks.goal: Make public entrypoints share production policy and exact results.
steps: Run the same captured request through CLI, canonical service and MCP using isolated homes.

tasks.title: Close replay and failure-prefix acceptance
tasks.goal: Exercise adversarial scope drift and recovery across the complete lifecycle path.
steps: Inject drift of intent, resolution, target, outputs and actually consumed predecessor artifacts at each continuation boundary.
Inject response loss and post-effect failures; compare durable state/evidence with emitted partial result.
Verify repeated request attaches to current operation and unrelated artifact refresh does not recreate source.
positive_cases: Exact replay resumes/observes once and current repeated verify remains fresh.
negative_cases: Cross-scope replay and changed consumed input refuse; response loss cannot duplicate work.
Observer failure does not rewrite the underlying domain outcome.
